defect: The nullable-annotation filter matches formatters whose type argument is already annotated (NullableAnnotation.Annotated) instead of those that are not (NotAnnotated).
why: The NullableReferenceTypeFormatter warning exists for formatters that implement IMessagePackFormatter<T> without the nullable annotation. With the test flipped it fires on correct formatters and stays silent on the ones it is meant to flag.
